Name: Ladder On Entry
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
Tired of breaking every stone on a mine floor only to run out of stamina before finding a ladder down?

This mod creates a ladder somewhere on the map immediately upon entering a mine floor. It replaces a random breakable stone, just as if a farmer had broken the stone themselves.

In Skull Cavern it will spawn a mine shaft 20% of the time instead, same as vanilla.

You can turn the mod off for higher difficulty mines in the config.

There is an optional hotkey to toggle the mod in the config.

You can use GMCM to edit the config.
